messages:
maria_ops: Heads-up — we got updated ETAs from the vendor. New ETA for the next H100 shipment is Tue 2026-02-17 (pending customs). Can infra owners confirm we still have circuits + PDUs reserved for the 3 racks in SJC-rack-24?

samir_infra: I can confirm circuits were requested, but PDUs were swapped last week. I don't have the final PDUs assigned to rack numbers yet. @jen_platform — did the PDU inventory mapping land in the spreadsheet? :eyes: 

jen_platform: Not final, still waiting on datacenter to confirm serials. I uploaded a draft mapping here: https://docs.internal/redwood/pdu-mapping (read-only) — note rack-24 shows 2x missing PDUs flagged.

li_devex: Quick question — do we need extra circuit capacity for canary nodes? Current plan has 40% headroom, but canary uses pre-warm nodes which spike for ~90s during rollout.

alex_sre: Canary spike pattern noted. Recommend reserving an extra 10A per rack for the burn-in window. If we can't get that, we should schedule canary outside peak power ops.

samir_infra: Agree with alex. I'll ask DC ops to tentatively hold +10A for rack-24 and rack-25. If they push back, we can fallback to staggered canary.

maria_ops: Thanks. Also, who owns the dedicated capacity reservation ticket with finance? I saw a note saying procurement needs PO ref #8812 to finalize.

jen_platform: That was assigned to me but finance asked for the finalized rack list. I held it pending PDU serials. If samir can confirm rack numbers, I'll push the PO today.

samir_infra: I should have final rack-run mapping by EOD PST. Will update the spreadsheet and ping finance.

maria_ops: Great. Two more small asks: 1) can the on-call SRE run a smoke script after rack power tests? 2) someone add a quick note to the rollout runbook about the PDU swapping step.

alex_sre: I can handle the smoke script. Minimal check I want: ssh to the management NIC, run `nvidia-smi` (gpu present), run a small inference container (we have a tiny image: registry.redwood/gpu-smoke:0.3) and verify 200ms response for a synthetic prompt. I can stub that into the runbook.

li_devex: I'll add the PDU swap note to the runbook and include the command snippet: 
```
# run smoke container
docker run --rm --gpus all registry.redwood/gpu-smoke:0.3 
# expect: OK and ~200ms
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Ticket INFRA-472 updated: "Reserve extra circuit headroom for rack-24/25" — assignee: samir_infra — status: waiting-on-dc-ops

maria_ops: Perfect. Last blocker is customs clearance timing — if the vendor slips beyond Tue, we should move the canary to next week. For planning, let's assume a 3 business-day customs variance. If customs slips, samir, please communicate new rack numbers and jen will delay PO until confirmed.

samir_infra: Will do. I'll update the ticket and the spreadsheet. Target: PO submitted by EOD tomorrow if PDU serials come in.

jen_platform: I'll queue the finance side for fast approval once PO is uploaded. Also leaving a sticky: double-check firmware baseline on delivered blades — some units have mixed firmware causing bios hangs in burn-in.

alex_sre: Good call. Add a pre-burnin firmware check step: `fw-util --verify --baseline v1.4.2` — fail -> hold.

maria_ops: Awesome. Thanks team. If anything changes, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
